🌼【2 Differnt Size】Do you worry that spoon is too small? Two different lengths of spoon can meet your meet. Short spoon length:12.5 cm/ 4.9 inch, long spoon length:17.5 cm / 6.9 inch.With light-weight size, they are convenient to store or carry out.

🌹【High Quality & Safety】: The flower spoons set is made of food grade 304 stainless steel, mirror polishing, rust free and durable.They are non-toxic, very safe and no rust, which can intimate contact with food.

🎁【Great Gift & Wide Use】: The cute flower spoon set is the best gift for friends and families, especially for office,home and coffee house. Easy to wash, suitable for mixing drinks like iced tea, iced coffee, milkshakes, root beer floats, yogurt etc.
